hook: Old City diversions *4 pm-10 pm* today for Guru Nanak procession
hook_b: Old City diversions *4 pm-10 pm* today for Guru Nanak procession
tldr: Traffic police will divert vehicles around Afzalgunj, SA Bazar, MJ Market and Putlibowli from 4 pm to 10 pm on Nov 21 as a Guru Nanak Jayanti procession leaves and returns to Ashok Bazar Gurudwara.

beats.what: A religious procession leaves Ashok Bazar Gurudwara on Nov 21 and loops back via Afzalgunj, SA Bazar, MJ Market, Putlibowli and Gowliguda Chaman.
beats.why: It marks Guru Nanak's 557th birth anniversary.
beats.care: Expect diversions via SJ Bridge, Rangamahal and Salar Jung Museum Rotary; traffic from Abids and Gandhi Bhavan is barred from Jambagh Road when the procession enters it.

effects.label: Jambagh Road closed to Abids traffic at times

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Diversions apply on a need basis; Hyderabad Traffic Police will post updates on its X page.

facts.t: Hyderabad's Sikh community is marking Guru Nanak Dev Ji's *557th* birth anniversary, with a joint Gurupurab at Nampally on Nov 24.

watch: Diversions lift once the procession returns to Ashok Bazar Gurudwara, by 10 pm.
